database_summary: This SQLite catalog mixes several domains: hardware sales (dimensional model: hardware_dim_*, hardware_fact_*), web CRM/orders (web_accounts, web_events, web_orders, web_sales_reps, web_region), a small university schema (university_*) and several unrelated example tables (StaffHours, SalaryDataset). The largest table is hardware_fact_sales_monthly (event/measurement grain). Dimension tables (hardware_dim_customer, hardware_dim_product) describe attributes for codes used in facts. Many tables are descriptive (current state) or event/measurement time-series. Join keys are mostly explicit (customer_code, product_code, OfferNo, StdNo, account_id, sales_rep_id). Some joins (facts to facts) can multiply rows; hardware_fact_sales_monthly is particularly large so joins to it risk explosion.

accepted.name: hardware_sales_monthly_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  h.date AS date,
  h.product_code AS product_code,
  p.division AS division,
  p.segment AS segment,
  p.category AS category,
  p.product AS product,
  p.variant AS variant,
  h.customer_code AS customer_code,
  c.customer AS customer,
  c.platform AS platform,
  c.channel AS channel,
  c.market AS market,
  c.sub_zone AS sub_zone,
  c.region AS region,
  h.sold_quantity AS sold_quantity,
  h.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS h
LEFT JOIN hardware_dim_product AS p
  ON h.product_code = p.product_code
LEFT JOIN hardware_dim_customer AS c
  ON h.customer_code = c.customer_code
accepted.description: Denormalized monthly hardware sales at the (date, product_code, customer_code) grain joined with product and customer dimension attributes. Useful for any analysis that needs sales measures together with product/category and customer/market attributes. | Use for: monthly sales by product/category and market/region; join sales with customer/product attributes for segmentation; time-series trends for specific product categories or customers

accepted.name: product_year_price_cost
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  gp.product_code AS product_code,
  gp.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year,
  gp.gross_price AS gross_price,
  mc.manufacturing_cost AS manufacturing_cost
FROM hardware_fact_gross_price AS gp
LEFT JOIN hardware_fact_manufacturing_cost AS mc
  ON gp.product_code = mc.product_code
  AND gp.fiscal_year = mc.cost_year
accepted.description: Per-product per-year view combining gross price and manufacturing cost aligned by year. Useful for margin analysis, price vs cost trends, and joining to sales by fiscal year. | Use for: compute gross margin or price minus cost by product-year; trend of price and cost over years for products; identify product-years with margin compression

accepted.name: customer_preinvoice_discount
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_code AS customer_code,
  fiscal_year AS fiscal_year,
  pre_invoice_discount_pct AS pre_invoice_discount_pct
FROM hardware_fact_pre_invoice_deductions
accepted.description: Normalized view of pre-invoice discount percentage per customer per fiscal year (passes through original columns). Useful for joining discount rates to sales or customer analyses. | Use for: apply customer discount percentage to invoice calculations; analyze discount rates by customer or fiscal year; join discounts to sales to compute net realized price

accepted.name: web_orders_by_account_and_day
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  account_id AS account_id,
  date(substr(occurred_at,1,10)) AS date,
  SUM(standard_qty) AS standard_qty_sum,
  SUM(gloss_qty) AS gloss_qty_sum,
  SUM(poster_qty) AS poster_qty_sum,
  SUM(total) AS total_qty_sum,
  SUM(standard_amt_usd) AS standard_amt_usd_sum,
  SUM(gloss_amt_usd) AS gloss_amt_usd_sum,
  SUM(poster_amt_usd) AS poster_amt_usd_sum,
  SUM(total_amt_usd) AS total_amt_usd_sum,
  COUNT(*) AS orders_count
FROM web_orders
GROUP BY account_id, date
accepted.description: Daily aggregated web orders measures per account (date truncated to day). Useful for trend analysis, daily KPIs, and joining with account attributes or sales reps. | Use for: daily revenue or quantity time series per account; compare product line amounts daily or aggregate by date range; compute average order value per day/account

accepted.name: account_with_region_salesrep
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.id AS id,
  a.name AS name,
  a.website AS website,
  a.lat AS lat,
  a.long AS long,
  a.primary_poc AS primary_poc,
  a.sales_rep_id AS sales_rep_id,
  r.id AS region_id,
  r.name AS region_name,
  s.name AS sales_rep_name
FROM web_accounts AS a
LEFT JOIN web_sales_reps AS s
  ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN web_region AS r
  ON s.region_id = r.id
accepted.description: Account dimension enriched with its assigned sales rep and sales rep region name. Useful to filter or aggregate orders/events by sales rep or region. | Use for: map accounts to sales reps and regions; spatial or regional aggregation of accounts; join orders/events to sales rep attributes

accepted.name: product_year_margin_metrics
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.product_code AS product_code,
  s.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year,
  SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS sold_quantity_sum,
  AVG(gp.gross_price) AS avg_gross_price,
  AVG(mc.manufacturing_cost) AS avg_manufacturing_cost,
  CASE WHEN AVG(gp.gross_price) IS NOT NULL THEN AVG(gp.gross_price) - AVG(mc.manufacturing_cost) ELSE NULL END AS avg_margin
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS s
LEFT JOIN hardware_fact_gross_price AS gp
  ON s.product_code = gp.product_code
  AND s.fiscal_year = gp.fiscal_year
LEFT JOIN hardware_fact_manufacturing_cost AS mc
  ON s.product_code = mc.product_code
  AND s.fiscal_year = mc.cost_year
GROUP BY s.product_code, s.fiscal_year
accepted.description: Per product per fiscal_year aggregated metrics combining sales (quantity) with price and cost where available. Exposes derived measures for margin and average price. Useful for profit and contribution analyses by product-year. | Use for: compute product-year margins and top-selling product-years; identify products with negative margins; compare average price vs cost for product portfolios

accepted.name: staff_events_ordered
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  StaffMember AS StaffMember,
  EventDate AS EventDate,
  EventTime AS EventTime,
  EventType AS EventType,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY StaffMember, EventDate ORDER BY EventTime) AS event_row_number
FROM StaffHours
accepted.description: Ordered staff event stream with row_number per StaffMember by EventDate and EventTime. Useful to detect sequences (Enter/Exit), compute session durations, or pick first/last event per day/person using row_number filters downstream. | Use for: compute duration between enter and exit per staff per day; find first or last event per staff per day; validate paired enter/exit sequences

accepted.name: university_offering_enrollment_counts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.OfferNo AS OfferNo,
  o.OffTerm AS OffTerm,
  o.OffYear AS OffYear,
  COUNT(e.StdNo) AS enrolled_students_count
FROM university_offering AS o
LEFT JOIN university_enrollment AS e
  ON o.OfferNo = e.OfferNo
GROUP BY o.OfferNo, o.OffTerm, o.OffYear
accepted.description: Counts of enrolled students per offering (OfferNo) and year/term by joining enrollment and offering. Useful for capacity, pass-rate, or retention analyses at the offering level. | Use for: class enrollment trends by term/year; identify under- or over-subscribed offerings; join offering counts to faculty for workload analysis

accepted.name: student_academic_profile
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  StdNo AS StdNo,
  StdFirstName AS StdFirstName,
  StdLastName AS StdLastName,
  StdCity AS StdCity,
  StdState AS StdState,
  StdZip AS StdZip,
  StdMajor AS StdMajor,
  StdClass AS StdClass,
  StdGPA AS StdGPA
FROM university_student
accepted.description: Student profile including major, class, GPA and basic identifiers. Useful as a base relation to join to enrollment or courses. | Use for: student-level GPA and major distributions; join students to enrollment/offering for grade analysis; filter cohorts by major or class year
